name: ROI Generation (thalamic nuclei)
summary: Generate a parcellation volume (and roi nifti files split into each label) for specific ROIs, or every ROI, for a parcellation from freesurfer output and/or input parcellation volume. This App can also inflate input parcellation volume toward non-white matter voxels.

inputs.description: The path to the anat/t1w datatype
The path to the DWI datatype
The path to the freesurfer datatype
The path to the parcellation/volume datatype
The path to the mask datatype containing the dwi brainmask

outputs.description: Parcellation nifti containing all the ROIs
Directory containing all of the ROIs

parameters.description:
Enter ROI numbers from key.txt (parcellation) or colorLUT (freesurfer) for the cortical ROIs wanted.

Example: 45,54

Enter the number of the subcortical ROI (if wanted).

Subcortical ROIs will be outputted with a leading 0 before the number (i.e. ROI012) for subcortical ROI 12. This is in order to avoid repetition in numbers between cortical and subcortical LUTs

Enter the number of the thalamic ROI (if wanted).

Please refer to this color lut (https://github.com/freesurfer/freesurfer/blob/dev/ThalamicNuclei/compressionLookupTable.txt) and your thalamic segmentation for specific ROI numbers

if ROI inflation into WM is wanted, specify the number of inflated voxels desired

example: 1

if ROI inflation into WM for thalamus segmentation is wanted, specify the number of inflated voxels desired

example: 1
